name: Montous
source:
An adult om’veri with an elegant green-blue appearance. With an elegant blue-gold appearance. His long, slender neck and part of his torso are covered in smooth, large scales of a light silvery-blue color that gleams with a soft metallic luster. Along the front of the neck and on the chest run protective segments of deep golden and dark green shades, creating a sharp contrast with the rest of the body. The head has an elongated, streamlined shape, and its upper part is adorned with a helmet-like growth of a golden color with small, sharp horns above dark, deep-set eyes. The back of the head smoothly features a sleek, dark sarantales collar that covers the upper part of the neck. Webbed wings of a steel-gray color with sharp claws on the bends extend outward from both sides of the base of the torso, with armor on the lower jaw.
Montous has a fiery temperament and is easily angered. He is disdainful toward neophytes—candidates for the sarantales.
